Since both P and Q lie on a circle centered at the origin, they must have the same distance from the origin.

For P(d, -d):
distance² = d² + (-d)² = 2d²

For Q(12-d, 2d-6):
distance² = (12-d)² + (2d-6)²

Setting these equal:
2d² = (12-d)² + (2d-6)²

Expanding:
2d² = 144 - 24d + d² + 4d² - 24d + 36
2d² = 5d² - 48d + 180
0 = 3d² - 48d + 180
0 = d² - 16d + 60

Using the quadratic formula or factoring:
(d-6)(d-10) = 0

So d = 6 or d = 10.

The sum of the two possible values is 6 + 10 = 16.
